text: The Fed is now signaling possible rate hikes in 2026 while payrolls just turned negative at -23,000 jobs — this stagflation-lite mix of sticky 3.4% inflation and weakening employment means the safety net of rate cuts is off the table, so tighten risk and avoid adding to speculative names.

NCLP.L is a large position sitting at a 15% loss with bearish technicals across the board — reduce this to a normal-sized position to free up capital and limit further damage if the downtrend continues.

Google at 23x earnings with 15% revenue growth and strong free cash flow is a quality compounder at a reasonable price — worth adding on any pullback as a core holding that can weather a tougher macro environment.
Meta at just 16x earnings with 22% revenue growth is arguably the cheapest quality name in big tech right now — this kind of value-plus-growth combination deserves a larger allocation.
Microsoft at 20x earnings with 18% revenue growth and a consistent beat streak is the definition of a high-quality compounder — add gradually as a reliable anchor for the portfolio.
